description: This file defines an abstract class 'PlacementFilterStrategy' which provides a base implementation for filtering and selecting placement strategies for grains in Orleans. It includes methods for initialization, populating grain properties, and retrieving placement filter properties.

classes.name: PlacementFilterStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class that serves as a base for strategies that filter silos on which grains can be placed.

methods.name: PlacementFilterStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the order of the placement filter strategy.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the placement filter strategy using grain properties, parsing the order property.

methods.name: AdditionalInitialize
methods.description: A virtual method intended to be overridden for additional initialization logic.

methods.name: PopulateGrainProperties
methods.description: Populates grain properties to specify placement strategy and additional properties.

methods.name: GetPlacementFilterGrainProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific placement filter property from grain properties.

methods.name: GetAdditionalGrainProperties
methods.description: Provides additional properties for placement, meant to be overridden.
